title: Register Agent
description: An Ed25519 keypair is generated. The agent registers its public key and proves identity via cryptographic challenge-response.

steps.label: Generate Keypair
steps.description: Ed25519 signing keypair is generated locally

steps.label: Register Public Key
steps.description: Agent registers its public key with the control plane

steps.label: Request Challenge
steps.description: Agent requests a cryptographic challenge from the control plane

steps.label: Sign & Verify
steps.description: Agent signs the challenge with its private key; control plane verifies the signature
steps.result: Identity verified — L3 Agent JWT issued
